title: Admitted dynamic-top irrigation composition for the minimal real SWAP5 + MODFLOW6 + Ribasim triangle

depends_on.F_APP07: scheduled gross irrigation -> Rutter -> net irrigation -> existing dynamic-top irrigation
depends_on.F_APP08: Rutter net surface irrigation -> dynamic-top irrigation field identity
depends_on.RM10: typed origin-bound real Ribasim realization receipt
depends_on.F_GC44: closed real SWAP + live MODFLOW fixed-interface authority without irrigation

scientific_question: Does the same qualified real Ribasim irrigation delivery compose with real Richards SWAP and live MODFLOW6 when it enters SWAP through the already admitted dynamic-top application semantics, allowing the surface boundary to partition delivered water into infiltration and ponding instead of forcing the complete delivery as an explicit Richards flux?

production_delta.purpose: add one generic opt-in dynamic-top runtime forcing carrier to the existing serialized Reference Richards backend
must_reuse: existing Richards solver dynamic top-boundary mode
production_delta.ownership_rule: generic dynamic-top forcing and explicit fixed top_flux are mutually exclusive; dual top-boundary ownership fails closed

hypotheses: The generic dynamic-top carrier is opt-in and leaves all existing fixed-flux, Black and Boesten routes byte/behavior compatible outside the new profile.
The frozen 36 cm/day net irrigation is bound as dynamic-top irrigation_rate, not as an explicit top_flux.
The dynamic-top provider returns an available flux/head regime without runoff for the frozen 0.0036 cm event and 1 cm ponding limit.
The real Richards predictor produces at least one accepted substep under the unchanged F-GC44 retry and temporal policy.
Surface-water mass is booked exactly once as 0.0036 cm external SWAP surface input, then internally partitioned into soil infiltration and ponding change with zero runoff and zero evaporation.
The real Richards + MODFLOW fixed-interface solve converges and the groundwater action/reaction ledger closes under the existing F-GC44 contract.
Rejected candidates leave the accepted Richards, management, Ribasim witness and groundwater ledger unchanged; replay from the same origins reproduces the same accepted endpoint.
Outer publication advances Richards SWAP and management SWAP exactly once and designates candidate B as accepted Ribasim surface-water state only after all preflights.
falsification_conditions: The generic dynamic-top route cannot represent the admitted F-APP07/F-APP08 irrigation field without changing dynamic-top physics.
The predictor still exhausts the unchanged F-GC44 retry/temporal envelope with zero accepted substeps.
Surface delivery cannot be reconciled as infiltration plus ponding/storage plus permitted surface losses.
Groundwater action/reaction or component mass balance fails.
nonclaims: RM13B is not reinterpreted as a pass; its direct fixed-top-flux hypothesis remains falsified.
No active runoff in the first RM14 profile.
No generic arbitrary dynamic-top policy beyond the existing B1.10/B1.11 restricted provider.
No production iMOD Coupler driver admission by RM14 alone.
